{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Define sentinel values
sentinel_values = [-999.0, -999, -999.00, -999.000]

# Filter out rows where either baseline or final biomarker is a sentinel value
df_clean = df[~df['biomarker_baseline'].isin(sentinel_values) & ~df['biomarker_final'].isin(sentinel_values)]

# Check the number of rows after filtering
df_clean.shape"}
